# Avatar & badge

- **layer** atom
- **source** `common/avatar/avatar.js`
- **status** n/a

`common/avatar/avatar.js` renders an Ant `Avatar` when `src` exists, otherwise falls back to the icon container with `FiUser` at 16px in a 40px tile. With `showBadge` it wraps in a small `Badge` (`overflowCount 100`). Badge counts are 20px tall, 10px/600, with a 3px white ring; dots are 10px.
